text: Consolidated revenue grew 12 percent year over year. Retail demand remained strong and digital services increased average revenue per user. Management described the operating outlook as resilient.
Free cash flow improved during the period and leverage remained stable. Capital expenditure was directed toward digital capacity and retail expansion.
The downside scenario identifies debt refinancing risk, regulatory uncertainty, and margin pressure in energy operations. A sustained decline in refining spreads could weaken near-term earnings.
